newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - April 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - April 21.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop, arrived in Seoul on Sunday to join hands with southern compatriots to prevent the peninsula and achieve peaceful national unification.
- Inter-Korean Red Cross talks are likely to be held early next month in Beijing to discuss the South Korea's food aid to the North.
- Seventeen armed North Korean soldiers stayed near the Military Demarcation Line for about an hour, but they returned to North Korea after South Korean soldiers gave warnings.
